text: Writing clean code is an important skill for every programmer. Clean code is easy to read and understand, even for people who did not write it. One key idea is using clear naming conventions, so variables and functions have meaningful names. Another important point is keeping functions small and focused on one task. When code is clean, it is much easier to maintain and update later. Other developers can quickly find and fix problems without confusion. In short, writing clean code saves time, reduces mistakes, and helps teams work together more effectively.
